outcome_evidence: The drawer is initially closed in left_ego_image at frame 0. The robot approaches and aligns with its handle, with acquisition visible in wrist_image around frames 74–83. The upper drawer then moves outward in image and left_ego_image at frames 87–105, exposing its interior and side walls. After releasing and withdrawing, the robot leaves the drawer visibly open through frame 141 in image and left_ego_image. No failed attempt or unintended side effect is established.
